facts.fact: ASIN held a sectoral consultation workshop in Cotonou on the draft Politique d'architecture des systèmes d'information de l'État (PASI), which sets organising principles, technical rules and standards to make public information systems interoperable, before final versions go to the Ministry of Digital Affairs.
